description: This file contains a PHP implementation of an XML-RPC server, including class definitions, functions for handling XML-RPC requests, server capabilities, and method registration, primarily facilitating server-side XML-RPC communication.

classes.name: xmlrpc_server
classes.description: Class providing the main XML-RPC server functionality, including request parsing, method execution, header handling, and debugging.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Executes the XML-RPC request and outputs the response, handling headers, compression, and debugging.

methods.name: add_to_map
methods.description: Registers a new method and its handler function in the server dispatch map.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Invokes a registered method, verifying parameters and callability, and returns an XML-RPC response object.
